surface_key_note: Surface keys: V, N, B, S, or NB (N and B), NBS. First string is what the templates render; any string counts for the check. Matching is case-insensitive.
vignette_note: Acute native-joint monoarthritis in an adult ED patient (the population of the 27% prior). No prosthetic joint, no immunosuppression, no injection drug use. T 37.8 C and serum WBC 10.6 are deliberately modest so no unscored finding moves the prior. The current result values (68 and 12 x 10^9/L) lie inside the Carpenter interval-LR bins 50 to 100 and 0 to 25, so the alternative interval-LR target applies to the same note. The clinician line (septic arthritis among the considerations) is a deliberate realism fact, identical across conditions and polarities.
